## Install

1. Download **Chomp.zip** below and unzip it.
2. Drag **Chomp.app** into Applications and open it.
3. First time only: macOS says it can't check Chomp for malware, because Chomp is free and not paid-signed with Apple. Click **Done**, then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down, and click **Open Anyway**.

Look for the little chest in your menu bar. macOS 13 or newer, Apple Silicon and Intel.
